Is device-login-history-based user attribution accurate enough to trust for clients without Identity Protection licensed?
Should device-posture signals (ZTA, vulnerabilities) count toward individual user risk score, or a separate environment-level concept?
Should real-time streaming (vs. scheduled polling) be in scope for v1?
